verses.text: Preserve me, God, for I take refuge in you.
lines: Preserve me, God, for I take refuge in you.

verses.text: My soul, you have said to Yahweh, “You are my Lord. Apart from you I have no good thing.”
lines: My soul, you have said to Yahweh, “You are my Lord.
Apart from you I have no good thing.”

verses.text: As for the saints who are in the earth, they are the excellent ones in whom is all my delight.
lines: As for the saints who are in the earth,
they are the excellent ones in whom is all my delight.

verses.text: Their sorrows shall be multiplied who give gifts to another god. Their drink offerings of blood I will not offer, nor take their names on my lips.
lines: Their sorrows shall be multiplied who give gifts to another god.
Their drink offerings of blood I will not offer,
nor take their names on my lips.

verses.text: Yahweh assigned my portion and my cup. You made my lot secure.
lines: Yahweh assigned my portion and my cup.
You made my lot secure.

verses.text: The lines have fallen to me in pleasant places. Yes, I have a good inheritance.
lines: The lines have fallen to me in pleasant places.
Yes, I have a good inheritance.

verses.text: I will bless Yahweh, who has given me counsel. Yes, my heart instructs me in the night seasons.
lines: I will bless Yahweh, who has given me counsel.
Yes, my heart instructs me in the night seasons.

verses.text: I have set Yahweh always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
lines: I have set Yahweh always before me.
Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.

verses.text: Therefore my heart is glad, and my tongue rejoices. My body shall also dwell in safety.
lines: Therefore my heart is glad, and my tongue rejoices.
My body shall also dwell in safety.

verses.text: For you will not leave my soul in Sheol, neither will you allow your holy one to see corruption.
lines: For you will not leave my soul in Sheol,
neither will you allow your holy one to see corruption.

verses.text: You will show me the path of life. In your presence is fullness of joy. In your right hand there are pleasures forever more.
lines: You will show me the path of life.
In your presence is fullness of joy.
In your right hand there are pleasures forever more.
